name: tw.com.ecpay.paymentgatewaykit.framework.atm.view.ATMPaymentTransparentActivity
description: This ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK screen handles an ATM bank-transfer checkout in the SDK’s transparent window style. It displays the order payment details and returns the result to the app when the flow ends.
disableEffect: ATM payment checkout on this route may not open or return its result to the app.
